🔧 拉兹的工具箱

ComfyUI 工作流程和实用工具的模块化集合


按照您的方式构建。用你的方式打破它。按照你的方式改进它。

Raz 的工具箱不是“一键式神奇工作流程”。它是一套模块化、即插即用的工具，专为那些喜欢在不牺牲速度或简单性的情况下实验、定制和进一步推动渲染的人们而设计。

每个组件都可以单独使用或与其他组件组合使用。您可以将它们合并到当前的工作流程中，替换特定的节点，或者弗兰肯斯坦整个事情，直到它尖叫为止。所有东西的结构都易于更换，标记清晰，并根据我个人的使用方式记录了注释。

🎯核心理念

  • 保持简单

  • 让它更快，而不是更重

  • 让用户决定推多远

  • 鼓励尝试，而不是限制

这适用于那些喜欢控制工作流程的人，而不是那些追求零点击自动化的人。非常适合构建、测试、训练 LoRA、调整批次或只是想要提高一致性而不需要每次渲染增加 10 分钟以上的创作者。

🔍 模块化“选择您的设置”风格

您可以：
✔ 将单个节点块添加到现有工作流程中
✔ 交换整个步骤部分（例如，细节精炼、高档分支）
✔ 堆叠多项调整并构建您自己的版本
✔ 或者使用完全组装的示例工作流程作为起点

🚀 准备好进行实验

拿走你需要的东西。忽略你不该做的事情。测试、突破、改进。

Raz 的工具箱旨在为您提供构建块，而不是规则。

🔧 Raz’s Toolbox

A modular collection of ComfyUI workflows and utility tools


Build it your way. Break it your way. Improve it your way.

Raz’s Toolbox is not a “one-button magic workflow.” It’s a set of modular, plug-and-play tools designed for people who like to experiment, customize, and push their renders further without sacrificing speed or simplicity.

Each component can be used on its own or combined with others. You can merge them into your current workflow, replace specific nodes, or Frankenstein the whole thing until it screams. Everything is structured to be easily swappable, labeled clearly, and documented with notes based on how I personally use them.

🎯 Core Philosophy

  • Keep it simple

  • Make it faster, not heavier

  • Let the user decide how far to push it

  • Encourage experimentation, not restriction

This is meant for people who like control over their workflow, not for those chasing zero-click automation. Ideal for creators who build, test, train LoRAs, tweak batches, or just want more consistency without adding 10+ minutes per render.

🔍 Modular “Choose Your Setup” Style

You can:
✔ Add a single node block to your existing workflow
✔ Swap whole step sections (e.g., detail refining, upscale branch)
✔ Stack multiple tweaks and build your own version
✔ Or use the fully assembled example workflows as a starting point

🚀 Ready To Experiment

Take what you need. Ignore what you don't. Test, break, improve.

Raz’s Toolbox is here to give you building blocks, not rules.
